aria-label.zh-CN: 根导航元素的可访问名称，未设置时使用语言包中的文案。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the root navigation element. The locale text is used when it is not set.

autoCollapse.zh-CN: 是否动态展示下一级锚点：只展开当前高亮链接所在的分支。
autoCollapse.en-US: Whether child links are shown dynamically: only the branch that holds the highlighted link is expanded.

children.zh-CN: `Anchor.Link` 元素，嵌套的 `Anchor.Link` 表示下一级锚点。
children.en-US: `Anchor.Link` elements. Nested `Anchor.Link` elements form the next level of links.

className.en-US: Class name of the root navigation element.

defaultAnchor.zh-CN: 挂载后默认高亮并滚动到该锚点，不触发 onChange 与 onClick。
defaultAnchor.en-US: Link highlighted and scrolled to after mounting. It does not call onChange or onClick.

getContainer.zh-CN: 指定滚动的容器；返回 null 时回落到 window。
getContainer.en-US: Returns the scrolling container. Returning null falls back to window.

maxHeight.zh-CN: 组件的 max-height，超出时显示滚动条。该属性覆盖 style 中的 max-height。
maxHeight.en-US: max-height of the component, with a scrollbar when exceeded. This prop overrides max-height in style.

maxWidth.zh-CN: 组件的 max-width，超出时显示省略。该属性覆盖 style 中的 max-width。
maxWidth.en-US: max-width of the component, truncating when exceeded. This prop overrides max-width in style.

offsetTop.zh-CN: 滚动内容距离容器顶部达到指定偏移量时触发当前链接切换。
offsetTop.en-US: Offset from the top of the container at which the current link switches while content scrolls.

onChange.zh-CN: 高亮的锚点改变时调用，参数为当前锚点与上一个锚点。
onChange.en-US: Called when the highlighted link changes, with the current and the previous link.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击锚点或在锚点上按 Enter 时调用，参数为原生 MouseEvent 或 KeyboardEvent 与当前锚点。
onClick.en-US: Called when a link is clicked or activated with Enter, with the native MouseEvent or KeyboardEvent and the current link.

position.zh-CN: showTooltip 开启时 Tooltip 的显示位置，可选值同 Tooltip 的 position。
position.en-US: Position of the Tooltip when showTooltip is on, with the same values as the Tooltip position.

ref.en-US: Reference to the root navigation element (`role="navigation"`).

scrollIntoViewOptions.zh-CN: 点击锚点滚动时传给 scroll-into-view-if-needed 的选项，与 scrollMotion、targetOffset 合并使用；未传 block 时为 `start`，仅传入 inline 时才同时调整横向位置。
scrollIntoViewOptions.en-US: Options passed to scroll-into-view-if-needed when a link is clicked, combined with scrollMotion and targetOffset. Without block the value is `start`; the horizontal position changes only when inline is passed.

scrollMotion.zh-CN: 点击锚点滚动时是否带动画（behavior 为 smooth）。
scrollMotion.en-US: Whether scrolling after a click is animated (behavior is smooth).

showTooltip.zh-CN: 文字缩略时是否显示浮层及相关配置：type 为浮层组件，支持 `tooltip`（默认）和 `popover`，opts 为传给浮层组件的属性。
showTooltip.en-US: Whether a popup shows when the text is truncated, with its options: type is the popup component, `tooltip` (default) or `popover`, and opts are passed to it.

style.en-US: Style of the root navigation element.

targetOffset.zh-CN: 锚点滚动结束时，目标距离容器顶部的偏移量。
targetOffset.en-US: Distance between the target and the top of the container when scrolling ends.

children.zh-CN: 下一级的 `Anchor.Link`，仅在链接展开时渲染。
children.en-US: Child `Anchor.Link` elements, rendered only while the link is expanded.

className.zh-CN: 链接项的类名，落在最外层的 div 上。
className.en-US: Class name of the link item, on its outermost div.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用，禁用后不响应点击跳转。
disabled.en-US: Whether the link is disabled and ignores clicks.

href.zh-CN: 跳转的目标，以 # 开头时按元素 id 查找，其余按 CSS 选择器查找。
href.en-US: Target of the link. A value starting with # is looked up by element id, anything else as a CSS selector.

ref.zh-CN: 链接项（`role="listitem"`）最外层 div 的引用。
ref.en-US: Reference to the outermost div of the link item (`role="listitem"`).

style.zh-CN: 链接项的样式，落在最外层的 div 上。
style.en-US: Style of the link item, on its outermost div.

title.zh-CN: 链接的文字内容，可以是节点；未开启 showTooltip 且为非空字符串时同时作为原生 title。
title.en-US: Text of the link, which can be a node. When showTooltip is off and the value is a non-empty string, it is also the native title.
